objective: Rerun the accepted 4.4 tok/s vendor DeepSeek cold-start path on the current pushed source head with diagnostic-only component tracing, then use the measured bottleneck to choose the next optimization direction toward 10 tok/s.

base_config.prompt: Please introduce France in a short paragraph.

validity_gates.correctness: France output must be semantically correct, coherent, and complete.

analysis_requirements: Aggregate fallback_profile.csv by phase and role, especially decode up/down fallback.
Use touch_us and cgroup memory/page-fault counters to estimate source/page exposure separately from hot compute.
Aggregate cpu_chunk_trace.csv by role, layer band, tensor, and thread to estimate scheduling/tail overhead.
Aggregate one_trace.csv into gate prefill/cache-hit/cache-miss timing.
Use ttft_trace.csv if present for prompt/cold-start timing markers.
Estimate non-MoE dense/attention residual as measured wall/decode time minus trace-attributed MoE components, with caveats for trace overhead.
Write a hard-bound artifact before any new runtime source edit.

promotion_rules.reason: Diagnostic trace env and CSV writing can perturb token rate; it is used only to locate the next bottleneck.
promotion_rules.future_sota_rule: If a compliant throughput-improving candidate appears, immediately record complete reproduction information, commit and push source/artifacts to ssd/vendor/deepseek-token-rate-16gb, then reproduce from pushed source.
